neha (AE): Kicking off SkylineBank POC. Scope: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM (users + nested groups), RBAC mapping (Okta groups -> tenant roles), DNS TXT domain verification, and Private/VPC option for PHI. Need feasibility + short onboarding runbook + cost delta Dedicated vs Private by EOD Fri. Looping @omar @rachel.

omar (SE): Clarify: SP + IdP SAML both? Any OIDC required? How large is directory?

rachel (Solutions Eng): Both SAML flows. No OIDC. Directory ~16k users, ~1k groups. Cutover plan requests ~48 req/s for 3 hours. They prefer DNS TXT for domain proofing.

vikram (Security): PHI -> require customer-managed KMS and SIEM forwarding. HSM optional (adds ~3-5w). Need retention window (90d vs 365d) - affects pricing. Also confirm redaction needs for assertion PII.

neha (AE): Buyer Q: committed 6M tokens/mo + 450k SCIM ops onboarding. Can we offer a scheduled burst to 48 req/s? What's the uplift Dedicated vs Private?

omar (SE): Default SCIM limit 10 req/s. Options: bulk import endpoint, scheduled burst (ops notice 72h), or managed ingestion. For 48 req/s/3h we can approve with monitoring and safety cutoff; ballpark cost uplift ~1.2x for that window. Private = higher setup/license; Dedicated = baseline + SLA premium (~20%). Need committed qps to firm numbers.

rachel (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a 1-page runbook: SAML cert rotate checks, SCIM chunking (250-500 users), example group->role regex, DNS TXT steps, and sample bulk import curl. Target: EOD tomorrow.

ovar (Security): I'll produce minimal compliance checklist (KMS vs HSM, SIEM HEC config, retention tiers, redaction options).

ops-bot: ticket#12045 created: "SkylineBank onboarding window" assigned to oncall-ops. Note: scheduled bursts require 72h notice.

neha (AE): Action items: @rachel runbook, @omar perf sim for 48 req/s using 2KB/user payload and 1-page Dedicated vs Private estimate, @vikram compliance checklist. I'll request sample SCIM CSV and cutover windows from SkylineBank. :thumbsup:
